title: Fluidstack adds 39 MW at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$830M)

sources.quote: The agreement represents approximately $830 million in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year term and includes two five-year extension options.

explain: Fluidstack expanded its Barber Lake lease by 39 megawatts, taking the whole 300-megawatt site, adding about $830 million of rent over 10 years. Google expanded its backstop of Fluidstack's payments.
